assist-or-defeat: If a hero recently dealt damage to or inflicted a debuff on an enemy that has been defeated, the hero is considered to have assisted in defeating that enemy.
base-damage: The amount of damage the attack or skill would have dealt. The amount is not affected by buffs and debuffs influencing damage of the attacking unit, nor those influencing Phys DEF, Magic DEF, shield or Stats of the unit being attacked.
basic-stats: A hero's basic stats include max HP, ATK, Phys DEF, and Magic DEF. If a hero's max HP is up or down in the battle, their current HP ratio remains the same.
battlefield-edge: The tile in each column closest to the corresponding team's side of the battlefield.
behind: The deeper the target is on their own side of the battlefield.
blind: An abnormal status. Blinded units are unable to hit enemies with normal attacks.
charmed: One of the abnormal states. Charmed units attack their own allies.
continuous-damage: Damage or HP loss caused by continuous debuffs such as Poison, Burn, or Bleed.
disarm: An abnormal status. Disarmed units cannot use normal attacks.
dodge-chance: The chance to dodge a normal attack. No damage is taken when dodging a normal attack.
fatal-blow: Damage that can reduce all of a unit's remaining HP.
freeze: One of the abnormal states. Frozen units cannot move or act.
fright: One of the abnormal states. Frightened units are afraid to get close to the caster.
frontmost: Closest to the enemy side of field
healthiest: Living unit that currently has the highest HP ratio.
hp-loss: Refers to any effects that reduce a unit's current HP, including physical damage, magic damage, true damage, and other HP-reducing effects.
immobilize: One of the abnormal states. Immobilized units cannot move or use movement skills.
interruption: A collective term for various abnormal states that can interrupt a unit's current skills or attacks, such as Stun, Frozen, etc.
invincible: Immune to all type of damage and control effects and become untargetable.
isolated: A unit with no allies within a 1-tile radius.
max-hp-reduction: This effect reduces a unit's maximum HP, with a cap of 25% of the unit's initial value. However, it does not apply in modes that track damage dealt, including modes like Dream Realm, Arcane Labyrinth, Battle Drills (battles against Elites and Bosses), Primal Lord, Guild Supremacy, Ravaged Realm, and Titan Reaver.
melee-damage: Damage dealt to enemies within 1 tile of the caster.
ranged-damage: Damage dealt to enemies more than 1 tile away from the caster.
rearmost: The deepest position on the target's side of the battlefield.
silence: An abnormal status. Silenced units can only use normal attacks.
steadfast: Cannot be knocked into the air, knocked back, or be involuntarily moved.
taunt: One of the abnormal states. Taunted units can only attack the caster, and only with normal attacks.
team-atk: The sum of the ATK of all deployed allied units.
weakest: Living unit that currently has the lowest HP ratio.
